India defeats England in FIH Hockey Pro League shoot-out

The Indian Men's Hockey Team secured a victory against England in the FIH Hockey Pro League. After a goalless regulation match, India won the penalty shoot-out with a score of 3-2. This match was the reverse fixture of their previous encounter.
